text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At long last, Biwa Hayahide and I are about to take on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When Biwa Hayahide was little, she panicked and seriously injured herself during a race when her younger sister, Narita Brian, overtook her. Stuck in a hospital bed afterward, she made a decision…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vowed to develop an equation that would allow her to overcome Narita Brian's raw talent so she wouldn't lose the next time they raced.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, my journey to develop a winning equation with Biwa Hayahide begins.
